proposals.spec_text: Server MUST shut down the dispatcher when receiving SIGTERM/SIGINT, draining active requests and completing all in-flight operations before exiting
proposals.actual_behavior: Only SIGINT handled via tokio::signal::ctrl_c(); SIGTERM not caught
proposals.proposed_change: Add SIGTERM signal handler using tokio::signal::unix::signal(SignalKind::terminate()) and tokio::select! on both signals in the shutdown future
proposals.rationale: SIGTERM is the standard shutdown signal in production (systemd, Docker, Kubernetes). Without it, the process gets force-killed risking data corruption.

proposals.spec_text: IPC handle contains a memory address (or opaque identifier) and a size field, address transmitted as a 64-bit integer
proposals.actual_behavior: IPC handle uses a 64-byte CUDA IPC memory handle (bytes) plus uint32 size, with server-side cudaIpcOpenMemHandle/cudaIpcCloseMemHandle
proposals.proposed_change: Update FR-011 to describe CUDA IPC handle mechanism (64-byte opaque blob + size). Remove assumption about same-address-space pointer sharing.
proposals.rationale: gRPC implies separate processes, so raw pointer sharing is incorrect. CUDA IPC handles are the correct cross-process GPU memory sharing mechanism. Code evolved to the right design.

proposals.proposed_change: No new spec needed. These are implementation details covered by the updated FR-011 (Proposal 2).
proposals.rationale: Helper functions are internal mechanism for fulfilling FR-002, FR-003, and FR-011. They don't represent a user-facing feature requiring specification.
